integrity: Rational coefficient certificate and executable exact-arithmetic checker are embedded; no numerical sampling is used for the infinite proof. Historical priority subject to external review.
scientific_limitations: Applies to smooth full-dimensional lattice three-polytopes with four or five facets, not arbitrary lattice three-polytopes. Depends on Kleinschmidt classification and Stanley nonnegativity; exact discriminant identities verified with a complete coefficient certificate. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Real-rooted Ehrhart numerators of smooth three-polytopes with at most five facets
